dedupe_keys.name: emplacements de stationnement reserves aux personnes a mobilite reduite pmr

description: Emplacements de stationnement réservés aux personnes à mobilité réduite (PMR) is a dataset listed in Open Data Hauts-de-Seine, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ville de Suresnes. Ce jeu de données localise les emplacements de stationnement réservés aux personnes à mobilité réduite (PMR) sur le territoire de Suresnes. Il est à noter que les emplacements PMR n'ont parfois pas de numéro de voie, en particulier pour les emplacements implantés à l'angle de deux rues. Coverage: Hauts-de-Seine. The portal files it under Equipement / Services. Its keywords are PMR, GIG-GIC, personnes à mobilité réduite. The portal shows 123 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2018-10-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-hauts-de-seine-fr-portal.
